cues: The definite integral from a to b is F of b minus F of a, where F is any anti-derivative; the constant cancels.
Integrate sine from nought to pi: the green hump has area exactly two.
text: The definite integral from a to b is F of b minus F of a, where F is any anti-derivative; the constant cancels. It measures signed area. Integrate sine from nought to pi: the green hump has area exactly two.
